rows.text: Culture neurons, microglia and astrocytes in separate vessels, side by side, each in its own medium.

phases.title: Load cells from the bench
phases.ports: FEED culture_medium_neurons_in 10 uL/min (cells_for_culture_neurons) | VENT culture_neurons_vent_out | rest capped
phases.watch: the cells arrives in culture_neurons and stays there; liquid leaves at culture_neurons_vent_out

phases.title: Load cells from the bench
phases.ports: FEED culture_medium_microglia_in 10 uL/min (cells_for_culture_microglia) | VENT microglia_vent_out | rest capped
phases.watch: the cells arrives in culture_microglia and stays there; liquid leaves at microglia_vent_out

phases.title: Load cells from the bench
phases.ports: FEED culture_medium_astrocytes_in 10 uL/min (cells_for_culture_astrocytes) | VENT astrocytes_vent_out | rest capped
phases.watch: the cells arrives in culture_astrocytes and stays there; liquid leaves at astrocytes_vent_out

phases.title: Culture apart 7 d (3 chambers, own medium each, change every 1 d)
phases.ports: FEED culture_medium_neurons_in 10 uL/min (culture_medium_neurons); culture_medium_microglia_in 10 uL/min (culture_medium_microglia); culture_medium_astrocytes_in 10 uL/min (culture_medium_astrocytes) | VENT culture_neurons_vent_out, microglia_vent_out, astrocytes_vent_out | rest capped
phases.watch: every 1 d, all 3 pumps together: each chamber's medium leaves through its own vent and nothing crosses the junction; check each culture on the microscope

rows.text: Continue culture of the three cell types sharing medium (co-culture or shared medium flow).

phases.title: Culture apart 1 d (3 chambers, own medium each, change every 12 h)
phases.ports: FEED culture_medium_neurons_in 10 uL/min (culture_medium_neurons); culture_medium_microglia_in 10 uL/min (culture_medium_microglia); culture_medium_astrocytes_in 10 uL/min (culture_medium_astrocytes) | VENT culture_neurons_vent_out, microglia_vent_out, astrocytes_vent_out | rest capped
phases.watch: every 12 h, all 3 pumps together: each chamber's medium leaves through its own vent and nothing crosses the junction; check each culture on the microscope

phases.title: Culture sharing medium 1 d (feed culture_neurons, vent the others)
phases.ports: FEED culture_medium_neurons_in 10 uL/min (culture_medium_neurons) | VENT microglia_vent_out, astrocytes_vent_out | rest capped
phases.watch: medium from culture_neurons reaches the other chambers through the junction and leaves at microglia_vent_out, astrocytes_vent_out

rows.text: Detach the cells with a dissociation enzyme.

phases.title: Exchange: dissociation_enzyme
phases.ports: FEED culture_medium_neurons_in 10 uL/min (dissociation_enzyme) | VENT culture_neurons_vent_out | rest capped
phases.watch: dissociation_enzyme reaches culture_neurons and leaves at culture_neurons_vent_out; no bubbles in the chamber

phases.title: Exchange: dissociation_enzyme
phases.ports: FEED culture_medium_microglia_in 10 uL/min (dissociation_enzyme) | VENT microglia_vent_out | rest capped
phases.watch: dissociation_enzyme reaches culture_microglia and leaves at microglia_vent_out; no bubbles in the chamber

phases.title: Exchange: dissociation_enzyme
phases.ports: FEED culture_medium_astrocytes_in 10 uL/min (dissociation_enzyme) | VENT astrocytes_vent_out | rest capped
phases.watch: dissociation_enzyme reaches culture_astrocytes and leaves at astrocytes_vent_out; no bubbles in the chamber

phases.title: Incubate
phases.ports: all capped
phases.watch: temperature steady at 37 C; nothing moving; capped ports not leaking

rows.text: Quench the dissociation enzyme.

phases.title: Mix quench_solution into the stream
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 10 uL/min (carrier_buffer); quench_solution_in 10 uL/min (quench_solution) | VENT cell_wash_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: material moves from culture_neurons through quench_join towards cell_wash_waste_out; streams merge evenly; no clogging; stop the pumps once the material has reached cell_wash (its next step)

rows.text: Centrifuge the cell suspension to pellet the cells.

phases.title: Exchange: wash_buffer
phases.ports: FEED wash_buffer_in 10 uL/min (wash_buffer) | VENT cell_wash_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: wash_buffer reaches cell_wash and leaves at cell_wash_waste_out; no bubbles in the chamber; cells stay in place

phases.title: Incubate
phases.ports: all capped
phases.watch: temperature steady at 22 C; nothing moving; capped ports not leaking

rows.text: Resuspend the cells in wash buffer.

phases.title: Exchange: wash_buffer
phases.ports: FEED wash_buffer_in 10 uL/min (wash_buffer) | VENT cell_wash_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: wash_buffer reaches cell_wash and leaves at cell_wash_waste_out; no bubbles in the chamber; cells stay in place

rows.text: Filter the suspension through a cell strainer to remove clumps.

phases.title: Pass through
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 10 uL/min (carrier_buffer) | VENT outlet_1 | rest capped
phases.watch: material moves from cell_wash through cell_filter towards outlet_1; streams merge evenly; no clogging; collect into the tube labelled 'chip1_triculture_dissociation_quench_cell_wash_filter: cells after step 7, for chip2_encapsulation_emulsion_break_capsule_wash_curing inlet_1'

rows.carries: filtered single cells (cell count checked on the bench)
rows.text: Hand-off out of chip1_triculture_dissociation_quench_cell_wash_filter (filtered single cells (cell count checked on the bench)): collect it from outlet_1 of chip1_triculture_dissociation_quench_cell_wash_filter into a tube, then do bench step(s) 8.
Count the cells and check viability.
rows.why: Cell counting and viability check are bench steps; the cell counter is not in the lab equipment list.

rows.carries: filtered single cells (cell count checked on the bench)
rows.text: Hand-off into chip2_encapsulation_emulsion_break_capsule_wash_curing (filtered single cells (cell count checked on the bench)): load the tube into the syringe on inlet_1 of chip2_encapsulation_emulsion_break_capsule_wash_curing (the sample line for chip2_encapsulation_emulsion_break_capsule_wash_curing's first step).
Wrap single cells in droplets of shell polymer around an aqueous core, formed in fluorinated oil at a chip junction.

phases.title: Encapsulate (co-flow)
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 1 uL/min (cells_suspension); core_solution_in 1 uL/min (core_solution); shell_polymer_in 2 uL/min (shell_polymer); fluorinated_oil_in 10 uL/min (fluorinated_oil) | VENT capsule_trap_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: steady droplet break-up at encap_junction (microscope); droplets travel on towards capsule_trap_waste_out; no oil backing up into the core line; stop the pumps once the material has reached capsule_trap (its next step)

rows.text: Break the emulsion with an emulsion-breaking agent and remove the oil phase.

phases.title: Exchange: emulsion_breaker
phases.ports: FEED emulsion_breaker_in 5 uL/min (emulsion_breaker) | VENT capsule_trap_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: emulsion_breaker reaches capsule_trap and leaves at capsule_trap_waste_out; no bubbles in the chamber

rows.text: Wash the capsules to remove leftover oil.

phases.title: Exchange: wash_buffer x3
phases.ports: FEED wash_buffer_in 20 uL/min (wash_buffer) | VENT capsule_trap_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: wash_buffer reaches capsule_trap and leaves at capsule_trap_waste_out; no bubbles in the chamber; capsules stay on the mesh

rows.text: Cure the capsule shells with light.

phases.title: Cure (405 nm)
phases.ports: all capped
phases.watch: 405 nm light over capsule_trap for 1 min; nothing flows

rows.text: Wash the cured capsules.

phases.title: Exchange: wash_buffer x2
phases.ports: FEED wash_buffer_in 20 uL/min (wash_buffer) | VENT capsule_trap_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: wash_buffer reaches capsule_trap and leaves at capsule_trap_waste_out; no bubbles in the chamber; capsules stay on the mesh

phases.title: Collect the capsules (outlet_1)
phases.ports: FEED wash_buffer_in 20 uL/min (collection_buffer) | VENT outlet_1 | rest capped
phases.watch: the capsules leaves capsule_trap through outlet_1 into the tube labelled 'chip2_encapsulation_emulsion_break_capsule_wash_curing: capsules after step 13, for chip3_lysis_rt_split_index_pcr_pool_release inlet_1'; never to waste

rows.text: Hand-off chip2_encapsulation_emulsion_break_capsule_wash_curing → chip3_lysis_rt_split_index_pcr_pool_release (cured capsules): move the outlet_1 tubing of chip2_encapsulation_emulsion_break_capsule_wash_curing to inlet_1 of chip3_lysis_rt_split_index_pcr_pool_release; keep every other port of both chips capped.
Lyse the cells inside the capsules (placeholder time and temperature).

phases.title: Load capsules from the hand-off from chip2_encapsulation_emulsion_break_capsule_wash_curing
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 20 uL/min (capsules_sample) | VENT reaction_trap_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: the capsules arrives in reaction_trap and stays there; liquid leaves at reaction_trap_waste_out

phases.title: Exchange: lysis_buffer
phases.ports: FEED wash_buffer_in 20 uL/min (lysis_buffer) | VENT reaction_trap_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: lysis_buffer reaches reaction_trap and leaves at reaction_trap_waste_out; no bubbles in the chamber; capsules stay on the mesh

phases.title: Incubate
phases.ports: all capped
phases.watch: temperature steady at 22 C; nothing moving; capped ports not leaking

rows.text: Wash the capsules after lysis.

phases.title: Exchange: wash_buffer x3
phases.ports: FEED wash_buffer_in 20 uL/min (wash_buffer) | VENT reaction_trap_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: wash_buffer reaches reaction_trap and leaves at reaction_trap_waste_out; no bubbles in the chamber; capsules stay on the mesh

rows.text: Reverse transcribe the RNA inside the capsules (placeholder time and temperature).

phases.title: Exchange: rt_mix
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 20 uL/min (rt_mix) | VENT reaction_trap_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: rt_mix reaches reaction_trap and leaves at reaction_trap_waste_out; no bubbles in the chamber; capsules stay on the mesh

phases.title: Incubate
phases.ports: all capped
phases.watch: temperature steady at 42 C; nothing moving; capped ports not leaking

rows.text: Wash the capsules after reverse transcription.

phases.title: Exchange: wash_buffer x2
phases.ports: FEED wash_buffer_in 20 uL/min (wash_buffer) | VENT reaction_trap_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: wash_buffer reaches reaction_trap and leaves at reaction_trap_waste_out; no bubbles in the chamber; capsules stay on the mesh

rows.text: Split the capsules into four sublibrary portions.

phases.title: Split
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 20 uL/min (carrier_buffer) | VENT pcr_1_vent_out, pcr_2_vent_out, pcr_3_vent_out, pcr_4_vent_out | rest capped
phases.watch: material moves from reaction_trap through split_2 towards pcr_1_vent_out, pcr_2_vent_out, pcr_3_vent_out, pcr_4_vent_out; streams merge evenly; no clogging; stop the pumps once the material is spread over pcr_1, pcr_2, pcr_3, pcr_4

rows.text: Run index PCR on each sublibrary with its own index (placeholder cycles, times and temperatures).

phases.title: Exchange: index_mix_1
phases.ports: FEED index_mix_1_in 20 uL/min (index_mix_1) | VENT pcr_1_vent_out | rest capped
phases.watch: index_mix_1 reaches pcr_1 and leaves at pcr_1_vent_out; no bubbles in the chamber; capsules stay on the mesh

phases.title: Exchange: index_mix_2
phases.ports: FEED index_mix_2_in 20 uL/min (index_mix_2) | VENT pcr_2_vent_out | rest capped
phases.watch: index_mix_2 reaches pcr_2 and leaves at pcr_2_vent_out; no bubbles in the chamber; capsules stay on the mesh

phases.title: Exchange: index_mix_3
phases.ports: FEED index_mix_3_in 20 uL/min (index_mix_3) | VENT pcr_3_vent_out | rest capped
phases.watch: index_mix_3 reaches pcr_3 and leaves at pcr_3_vent_out; no bubbles in the chamber; capsules stay on the mesh

phases.title: Exchange: index_mix_4
phases.ports: FEED index_mix_4_in 20 uL/min (index_mix_4) | VENT pcr_4_vent_out | rest capped
phases.watch: index_mix_4 reaches pcr_4 and leaves at pcr_4_vent_out; no bubbles in the chamber; capsules stay on the mesh

phases.title: Thermal cycling: N cycles
phases.ports: all capped
phases.watch: block runs the program on thermal zone pcr_zone; ports stay capped; no bubbles or evaporation in pcr_4

rows.text: Release the cDNA from the capsules by digesting the shell with a shell-digesting enzyme (placeholder time and temperature).

phases.title: Move capsules: pcr_1 → release_trap
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 20 uL/min (carrier_buffer) | VENT release_trap_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: the capsules arrives in release_trap and stays there; liquid leaves at release_trap_waste_out

phases.title: Release with release_enzyme
phases.ports: FEED release_enzyme_in 20 uL/min (release_enzyme) | VENT outlet_1 | rest capped
phases.watch: material leaves through outlet_1 into a collection tube; stop when release_trap is clear; collect into the tube labelled 'chip3_lysis_rt_split_index_pcr_pool_release: nucleic_acid after step 20, for chip4_bead_binding_wash_elution inlet_1'

rows.text: Hand-off chip3_lysis_rt_split_index_pcr_pool_release → chip4_bead_binding_wash_elution (released cDNA): move the outlet_1 tubing of chip3_lysis_rt_split_index_pcr_pool_release to inlet_1 of chip4_bead_binding_wash_elution; keep every other port of both chips capped.
Bind the released cDNA to magnetic beads.

phases.title: Exchange: magnetic_beads
phases.ports: FEED magnetic_beads_in 20 uL/min (magnetic_beads) | VENT bead_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: magnetic_beads reaches bead_chamber and leaves at bead_waste_out; no bubbles in the chamber

phases.title: Load nucleic_acid from the hand-off from chip3_lysis_rt_split_index_pcr_pool_release
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 20 uL/min (nucleic_acid_sample) | VENT bead_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: the nucleic_acid arrives in bead_chamber; stop the pump as soon as it is there, before it runs on towards bead_waste_out

phases.title: Incubate
phases.ports: all capped
phases.watch: temperature steady at 22 C; nothing moving; capped ports not leaking

rows.text: Wash the beads on a magnet.

phases.title: Exchange: ethanol_wash x2
phases.ports: FEED ethanol_wash_in 20 uL/min (ethanol_wash) | VENT bead_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: ethanol_wash reaches bead_chamber and leaves at bead_waste_out; no bubbles in the chamber; magnet on, beads stay put

rows.text: Elute the library from the beads.

phases.title: Exchange: elution_buffer
phases.ports: FEED elution_buffer_in 20 uL/min (elution_buffer) | VENT bead_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: elution_buffer reaches bead_chamber and leaves at bead_waste_out; no bubbles in the chamber; magnet on, beads stay put

phases.title: Incubate
phases.ports: all capped
phases.watch: temperature steady at 22 C; nothing moving; capped ports not leaking

phases.title: Collect the library (outlet_1)
phases.ports: FEED elution_buffer_in 20 uL/min (collection_buffer) | VENT outlet_1 | rest capped
phases.watch: the library leaves bead_chamber through outlet_1 into the tube labelled 'chip4_bead_binding_wash_elution: library after step 23'; magnet on so the beads stay behind; never to waste

rows.text: Pool the four cleaned-up sublibraries for sequencing.

phases.title: Pool
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 20 uL/min (library_suspension) | VENT outlet_1 | rest capped
phases.watch: material moves from the inlet through pool_2 towards outlet_1; streams merge evenly; no clogging

phases.title: Collect the library (outlet_1)
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 20 uL/min (collection_buffer) | VENT outlet_1 | rest capped
phases.watch: the library leaves pool_2 through outlet_1 into the tube labelled 'chip3_lysis_rt_split_index_pcr_pool_release: library after step 24, for chip4_bead_binding_wash_elution inlet_1'; never to waste

rows.text: Measure library concentration and fragment size.
rows.why: Library concentration and size measurement are done on the bench (fluorometer is not on the lab list).
